cards.main_contribution: Utilized graph summarization techniques to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource usage.
overlaps: Generated multiple smaller subgraphs from the large-scale graph
Performed model training on these subgraphs
The subgraphs generated by graph summarization were much smaller than the original graph

quotes.interpretation: The paper discusses the shift towards using deep learning, particularly GNNs, for graph summarization to address the computational challenges posed by large-scale graphs.
quotes.quote: In the past, most graph summarization techniques sought to capture the most important part of a graph statistically. However, today, the high dimensionality and complexity of modern graph data are making deep learning techniques more popular. Hence, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of progress in deep learning summarization techniques that rely on graph neural networks (GNNs).
